name: mirage
text: Yes, 1, 2, 3 and 5 are built, but #1 and #2 only record on paper and none of them show as cards on the Live tab. #1, score-event buying: a paper record only, no orders. #2, the lower-confidence tier (75-89%): a paper record, plus the $0.10 middle tier from v1.0.3. #3, two sharp sources agreeing: built. #5, live bids under fair pulled on any socket move: built. Live bids and live orders are off or paper by default, and Settings › Live features is the master switch. The Live tab shows the sockets, the games it's watching and the model's verdict per game, as in your screenshot. Your earlier 1-2-4-5 request numbered the list differently, so the cross-exchange hedge was never built until v1.0.8. It's now a paper journal only, not on the Live board yet, and I can't order Kalshi's leg under the standing rule. Next I'll put the paper records on the Live board so you can see them, unless you want something else first.
